$schema.description: the schema this file is written to

maskExpansion.description: how far the mask's opening reaches past a pad all round

silkscreenWidth.description: the width a silkscreen outline is drawn with when it names none

letterStroke.description: how thick a letter's stroke is, as a share of its height

curveSteps.description: how many straight pieces a curve is drawn with where a format has no curve

cornerSteps.description: how many straight pieces a quarter of a pad's rounded corner is drawn with

arcError.description: how far a round offset followed in straight pieces may stand off the true curve: what a pour keeps its gap by, the gap grown by it so no copper is poured nearer than the rule

designator.description: How a designator is set where nothing says where: the gap above the part, the least and most its letters may be, and the share of the part's width they take; and how far each letter advances, as a share of its height.

gap.description: how far above the part's box its designator stands, in millimetres

least.description: the least height its letters are written at, in millimetres

widthShare.description: the share of the part's width its letters are high, between those

advance.description: how far each letter advances, as a share of its height

teardrops.description: How a drop is shaped, beyond what a pcb sets of it.

curveSteps.description: how many straight steps follow a curved side of a drop

widestShare.description: the widest a drop's base may be, as a share of what it enters: past that its base would stand out of the copper as a shelf

insideEdge.description: how far the base stands from the middle of the copper on its line towards the copper's edge, as a share of the way: inside the copper, so nothing of the drop stands out behind the track

halvings.description: how many halvings find where copper ends along a line, or how wide a drop's side may be

looks.description: how many steps a line beside the track is looked along for any of the copper

tolerance.description: how much nearer than a rule a value may be and still pass, in millimetres

namedGaps.description: how many narrow gaps are named one by one

areas.description: how the pcb as made is drawn as areas for an editor and its 3D view

steps.description: how many straight steps a quarter of a round end, a disc, an arc or a drill is drawn with

tolerance.description: how far an area's outline may move when it is simplified for a view, in millimetres
